name: Kafei
source:
Leader of the Ruuin Knight Troupe.
A slender man with a sharp gaze who doesn't talk much.
He used to be part of a resistance group that fought against the knights but he fell into a trap set by [url=/c43962]Levias[/url] and ended up swearing loyalty to him afterwards.
A battle enthusiast who naturally enjoys fighting.
